Problem Statement:
Given a number N followed by 2 lists A and B of N integers each. Form a 3rd list C of size N where each element of list C is the sum the respective elements in lists A and B.
input_spec: A number N followed by 2 lists A and B of N integers each. N <= 100000.
output_spec: A 3rd list C of size N where each element is the sum of the respective elements in lists A and B.
